[head=2][color=#e8b04b]Sector Crescent[/color][/head]
Sector Crescent was never meant to matter. It was just one of countless frontier sectors under the Kaiser's rule.
Far from the Imperial homelands within the greater Domain, it existed primarily as a resource frontier, a cold collection of mining worlds and refinery stations feeding material back into the Domain. Plasma extraction was what made the region valuable to the Mandate.
For many generations, the Imperial citizenry of Crescent lived quiet and predictable lives beneath Imperial authority. Workers extracted ore and plasma in the Kaiser's name in exchange for stable, simple living. Noble overseers governed from isolated estates and orbital courts. Freight moved endlessly throughout the inner systems.
Then the revolutions began.
